links.outcome: GPT-3.5 accuracy on guideline-based neuraxial bleeding risk assessment versus truth table
links.effect: Baseline performance slightly above chance; with detailed prompts and explicit guidelines, AUC 0.70 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.77); performance varied among medication classes.
links.quote: Baseline performance of GPT-3.5 was slightly above chance.

unlisted_practices: Structured prompt guidance with explicit guideline text improves LLM accuracy

screen.practice: structured prompt guidance with explicit guideline instructions
screen.reason: The study tests hypothetical clinical vignettes comparing zero-shot/minimal prompts with structured, guideline-explicit prompt designs to evaluate their impact on LLM accuracy.

primary.practice: structured prompt engineering and guideline grounding
